blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 MANILA, Philippines–Gilas Pilipinas fell short of bringing home the gold after bowing to host Japan, 21-11, in the women’s U-23 3×3 basketball of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 on Friday at Kinjo Futo Station Square. Kacey dela Rosa, Kennan Ka, Amyah Espanol and Maria Pasilang were left to spend most of the match trying to catch up with Japan and settled for the silver medal finish. The closest Gilas could get was at four points multiple times, the last at 12-8 on a basket by Dela Rosa with three […]...
